pages.title: Cultist Shrines
pages.text: In the ashen reaches, Cultists gather on dark platforms lit by soul fire. Three always keep watch.$(br2)Look closely at what they have built around the old altar: Voidstone, crying obsidian, candles waiting to be lit.$(br2)They have been building the $(l)Ritual of Waking$().

Everything the ritual needs is already in place, save the candlelight and the $(l)Void Heart$().$(br2)Their supply chest often holds a $(item)Lost Page$(), and sometimes an $(item)Echo Shard$().$(br2)$(o)Clear the platform before you finish their work. You will want the room.$()
